rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Privacy-aware MCP server that automatically detects sensitive content in prompts and routes them to local Ollama instances instead of cloud LLMs. Uses keyword-based pattern matching to identify PII, PHI, credentials, and other sensitive data, then provides audit logging for compliance tracking. Includes consent management workflows and a policy engine for customizable routing decisions. Built in Rust for performance, with compliance documentation and scripts for regulated industry deployments.
